forms.title: Mozambique eVisa and eTA — online application (VFS Global for the National Immigration Service)
forms.stoppedAt: 'Apply Now' on evisa.gov.mz opens a log-in that sends a one-time password to a registered email (user type Normal or Oil & Gas); the application opens only after signing up. Only the public pre-login steps were read.

steps.name: Apply Online
notices: Fill out the application on our platform. Provide your details and upload necessary documents. If you have dual nationality, use the passport you will travel with.

steps.name: Download & Print
notices: Check your email for the preliminary eVisa/ eTA. If approved, download the PDF, print it, and be sure to have it ready for both boarding and your arrival in Mozambique.
